channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Ao vivo: Lula sanciona destinação de recursos para o Brasil Soberano
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva signed PLV No. 7 of 2026, allocating resources to the Brazil Sovereign program, designed to support companies affected by U.S. import tariffs. The initiative aims to preserve jobs, strengthen productive capacity, and enhance the competitiveness of Brazilian firms. The signing ceremony took place at 3 p.m.

item.title: Lula anuncia R$ 18,5 bilhões para empresas afetadas pelo tarifaço
item.description: President Lula announced a provisional measure allocating R$ 18.5 billion to support Brazilian companies affected by 25% U.S. tariffs on products such as biofuels, chemicals, machinery, footwear, and apparel. The funding is part of the third phase of the Brazil Sovereign Plan and aims to offset estimated export losses of up to US$ 11 billion. The announcement coincided with the tariffs taking effect.

item.title: Lula libera R$ 18,5 bilhões em crédito para empresas afetadas por tarifaço do governo Trump
item.description: President Lula announced the release of R$18.5 billion in credit for companies affected by U.S. tariffs and the Middle East war, complementing a law that already allocated R$15 billion to the Brazil Sovereign Plan. The measures aim to support sectors such as industry, agriculture, and mining, with conditions like job maintenance, following negotiations with the U.S. that proved unfruitful due to U.S. demands deemed non-negotiable, including changes to PIX and critical minerals legislation.

item.title: Planalto anuncia socorro de R$ 18,5 bi para setores atingidos pelo tarifaço dos EUA
item.description: The federal government announced an R$18.5 billion credit package for exporters and supply chains affected by U.S. tariffs and the Middle East war, covering industry, agribusiness, mining, fishing, aquaculture, and forestry. President Lula also sanctioned a law allocating R$15 billion to the Brazil Sovereign Plan, expanding credit access during international trade instability. Beneficiary companies must preserve part of their workforce as a condition.

item.title: Flávio usará colete à prova de balas em eventos públicos
item.description: Senator and presidential pre-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) will begin wearing bulletproof vests at public events due to an increase in threats identified by his security team. The measure, reported by Folha de S.Paulo, aims to ensure his physical safety during public appearances. His protection is carried out by Federal Police agents.

item.title: Governo Lula anuncia R$ 18,5 bilhões em crédito para socorrer setores afetados por tarifaço de Trump
item.description: The Lula government announced R$18.5 billion in subsidized credit through the Brazil Sovereign plan to support companies affected by the new U.S. tariffs. The measure aims to mitigate the impact of American trade measures and international uncertainty, taking effect on the same day the U.S. tariffs come into force.

item.title: Ciro Nogueira avisa Flávio Bolsonaro que PP ficará neutro na eleição presidencial e frustra PL
item.description: PP national president Ciro Nogueira informed Flávio Bolsonaro that the party will maintain neutrality in the 2026 presidential election, frustrating the senator’s efforts to secure support from the PP-União Brasil federation. The decision allows state directories to freely choose candidates, with PP likely backing Bolsonaro in São Paulo and Lula in Paraíba. União Brasil is also expected to adopt neutrality due to its federation with PP.

item.title: Escritório de Flávio Bolsonaro emitiu R$ 1,5 milhão em notas para empresas ligadas a Daniel Vorcaro, diz site
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's law office issued three invoices totaling R$1.5 million to two companies linked to Daniel Vorcaro, controller of Banco Master. Two R$500,000 invoices to Copenhagen Consultoria e Assessoria S.A., issued in April 2025, were canceled the same day; a third R$500,000 invoice to Contábil Correa, issued two days later, remains active. The companies share an address in São Caetano do Sul (SP) and are tied to accountant Rogério Lourenço Novo, previously investigated for issuing fake invoices in a scheme causing over R$100 million in losses.

item.title: Mercado ouve ideias e não compra os candidatos
item.description: Advisors for Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro presented government proposals to investors in Faria Lima, but the market showed skepticism toward the candidates. José Sergio Gabrielli (PT) and Daniella Marques (PL) sought to convey economic visions from their campaigns, yet financial agents remained unconvinced about the viability or credibility of the candidacies. The dialogue highlighted a disconnect between the ideas discussed and the perceived trust in the candidates.

item.title: Caiado critica Flávio Bolsonaro por falas sobre urnas eletrônicas
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) criticized Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) for using a meeting with 42 ambassadors to question Brazil's electronic voting machines instead of discussing economic interests like soybean exports and investment attraction. Caiado noted that Flávio compared Brazilian voting machines to those of Smartmatic, a company accused of fraud in Venezuela, despite the TSE confirming Brazil does not use Smartmatic equipment. The PL pre-candidate also urged countries to send election observers for 2026, stating he is not questioning the Brazilian voting system.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro é um maracujá murcho, mas ainda não caiu do pé
item.description: The author uses the analogy of a wilted passion fruit to describe Flávio Bolsonaro as politically weakened but not yet fully defeated or discarded, suggesting that despite losing influence, he remains in the political arena. The piece is an ironic, metaphorical critique with no concrete details about political actions, focusing on the perception of decline.

item.title: Brasil tem queda de 2,5% nos casos de feminicídio no 1º semestre; 10 estados vão na contramão
item.description: Brazil recorded a 2.5% drop in femicide cases in the first half of 2026, with 741 cases compared to 760 in 2025. The decline was driven by the North (-20.0%) and Northeast (-19.9%) regions, while 10 states, including Goiás (+113%), Sergipe (+71.4%) and Amazonas (+66.7%), saw increases. The federal government maintains its national pact to combat femicide, citing progress in speeding up protective measures.

item.title: Crusoé: Petista lidera todos os cenários para o governo do RN, aponta AtlasIntel
item.description: An AtlasIntel/94 FM poll released on January 21 shows Cadu Xavier (PT), the state's finance secretary, leading all scenarios for the governorship of Rio Grande do Norte, including runoff scenarios against Álvaro Dias (PL) and Allyson Bezerra (União Brasil). The survey indicates Cadu would defeat both opponents in potential second-round matchups.

item.title: Crusoé: Missão esclarece dúvidas sobre seu plano de governo
item.description: The Missão party, led by candidate Renan Santos, released its government plan, featuring proposals such as ending racial quotas, reducing the number of municipalities, creating a 'Rouanet Law' for prisons, and establishing a media code. The document sparked mixed reactions, with some praised elements and others considered controversial.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro comete outra bobagem
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro again questions the integrity of electronic voting machines in a meeting with ambassadors, a move criticized by Valdemar Costa Neto as evidence of his unpreparedness for the presidency. The author argues such claims, previously used by Jair Bolsonaro, serve only to preemptively justify a potential loss and foster baseless distrust, risking penalties and damaging credibility. Despite acknowledging the electoral system previously elected Bolsonaros, the text condemns the repetition of ineffective tactics and draws a parallel to Daniel Ortega’s authoritarian stance in Nicaragua, where elections are dismissed as tools for power consolidation.

item.title: Renan Santos chama Eduardo Bolsonaro de “vassalo de Trump” após Green Card
item.description: Renan Santos, MBL coordinator and presidential pre-candidate for the Missão party, criticized Eduardo Bolsonaro by calling him a "vassal of Trump" following the granting of a Green Card to the federal deputy on leave, who has been in the U.S. since the beginning of the year. Santos implied that the residency authorization reflects subservience to the former U.S. president.

item.title: Marcola de Lula e número 2 da Secom deixam governo para atuar na campanha
item.description: Chief of Staff to President Lula, Marco Aurélio Santana Ribeiro (Marcola), and the executive secretary of the Secom, Tiago César dos Santos, were dismissed to work on the petista’s 2026 re-election campaign. Both left government roles to focus full-time on electoral strategy.

item.title: Insinuação de Flávio Bolsonaro sobre fraude em urnas é desculpa antecipada para a derrota
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro reiterated the claim of electronic ballot fraud in a meeting with ambassadors, maintaining the Bolsonarist narrative that electoral defeats occur only due to system manipulation. This narrative serves as a preemptive justification for potential losses in 2026, reinforcing internal cohesion despite legal consequences from January 8 and Jair Bolsonaro’s ineligibility. The statement reflects an inflexible dogma that rejects political accountability and fuels opposition resistance as blind faith.

item.title: Presidente da Coreia do Sul vem ao Brasil com foco em IA e chips
item.description: South Korean President Lee Jae Myung will visit Brazil on July 27 to deepen the strategic partnership with President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, focusing on semiconductors, artificial intelligence, and critical minerals. The visit, accompanied by First Lady Kim Hea Kyung, aims to expand bilateral trade (which reached US$10.8 billion in 2025) and integrate high-tech supply chains between the two nations.

item.title: Cineasta Luiz Carlos Barreto morre aos 98 anos no RJ
item.description: Brazilian filmmaker and producer Luiz Carlos Barreto died at 98 in Rio de Janeiro after being hospitalized for a lung infection. President Lula declared three days of official mourning, praising Barreto's pivotal role in national cinema. He produced classics such as 'Dona Flor and Her Two Husbands' and collaborated with figures like Glauber Rocha and his son Bruno Barreto.

item.title: Irmão de Michelle rebate crítica de Eduardo Bolsonaro à madrasta
item.description: Eduardo Torres, brother of Michelle Bolsonaro and pre-candidate for district deputy in DF, rebuked Eduardo Bolsonaro's criticism of the stepmother, suggesting the objections stem from Michelle's political independence. He mimicked critics saying she should follow others' positions and asked when the group will work against Lula. Michelle had posted a June video criticizing PL alliances and claiming mistreatment by Flávio Bolsonaro, but later defended group unity.

item.title: Comissão de Ética quer fechar brecha para uso de voo da FAB em campanha
item.description: The Public Ethics Commission (CEP) and the Attorney General’s Office (AGU) are tightening rules that prohibit the use of FAB flights and public resources for political-electoral events, even when disguised as official activities. The update to Resolution 7 of 2002 removed loopholes that allowed agenda registration as justification, making clear that any misuse will be punished without further judgment. Authorities wishing to attend campaign events must now take unpaid leave from their positions.

item.title: PT prepara ação no TSE contra Flávio após 'ataque coordenado' contra urnas
item.description: The PT, through its Brazil of Hope federation, is preparing a lawsuit at the TSE against Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) over his statements on electronic voting machines made at an event with foreign ambassadors. The party views the remarks as a 'coordinated attack' on Brazil’s electoral system. The initiative aims to hold the presidential pre-candidate accountable for spreading disinformation about vote integrity.

item.title: Em evento com Lula, CEO da Stellantis faz piada com bateria “asiática”
item.description: Stellantis CEO Antonio Filosa joked about an 'Asian' battery in a malfunctioning microphone during an event with President Lula at the Planalto Palace, commemorating Fiat's 50 years in Brazil. The remark drew laughter from attendees, including Vice President Geraldo Alckmin, though Lula did not respond. Lula later jokingly asked the press to leave so the meeting could continue in a more relaxed manner.

item.title: Lula brinca sobre abrir reunião à imprensa: “Se notícia for ruim, não”
item.description: President Lula joked about allowing press access to the Stellantis meeting, saying he’d only let them in if the news was good, and later asked them to leave when time ran out. The meeting celebrated Fiat’s 50th anniversary in Brazil and included officials such as Alckmin, ministers, and Stellantis executives. The initial broadcast was cut and later restarted on a new YouTube live stream from the president’s channel.

item.title: O ensinamento de Caiado a Flávio, após fala sobre urnas em evento com embaixadores
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado criticized Flávio Bolsonaro for discussing electronic voting machines in a meeting with over 40 ambassadors, arguing the opportunity could have been used to attract investments and open markets. He noted that Flávio repeated the false claim that Brazilian voting machines are made by the Venezuelan company Smartmatic, which has been debunked by the TSE, and suggested the focus should have been on economic and international relations issues. Caiado positions himself as Flávio’s rival in the race for right-wing voters in the 2026 presidential election.

item.title: Parte do STF vê guinada extremista de Flávio sobre urna, já Kassio minimiza comparação com Bolsonaro
item.description: At least three Supreme Court justices say Senator Flávio Bolsonaro has taken an extremist turn by spreading misinformation about electronic voting machines, inspired by the U.S. government. Justice Kassio Nunes Marques, however, downplays comparisons between Flávio and former President Jair Bolsonaro. The remarks come amid growing debate over the integrity of Brazil’s electoral system.

item.title: Código-fonte da urna está aberto desde 2025; post imita portal para enganar
item.description: Social media posts are impersonating G1 news to falsely claim that Minister André Mendonça ordered the opening of electronic voting machines' source code for audit. In reality, the source code has been publicly available since 2025, and the claim is a piece of disinformation aimed at undermining trust in Brazil's electoral system.

item.title: No Senado dos EUA, Greer diz que desmatamento deu "vantagem" ao Brasil
item.description: USTR chief Jamieson Greer claimed that deforestation in Brazil gives Brazilian farmers a competitive advantage, justifying 25% U.S. tariffs under Section 301. He said the measures followed years of complaints about unfair trade practices, including deforestation and Pix. Democratic Senator Michael Bennet criticized the policy, arguing it harms U.S. farmers and benefits Brazil in global agricultural trade.

item.title: Fala de Flávio sobre urnas é uma aposta no 'TSE amigo', avalia ala do STF
item.description: Members of the STF reacted to Senator and presidential pre-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro’s criticism of electronic voting machines during an event with ambassadors in Brasília, suggesting his remarks are a bet on a 'friendly TSE'.

item.title: Para Centrão, Flávio dá tiro no pé ao recorrer a fake news para atacar urnas eletrônicas
item.description: Centrão leaders labeled Flávio Bolsonaro's use of fake news about Smartmatic-made electronic voting machines as a 'self-inflicted wound,' arguing it undermines prospects for alliances with centrist parties and alienates independent voters. They note this adds to existing crises involving Daniel Vorcaro, Vorcaro, and tariff policy, hindering coalition-building and vice-presidential selection ahead of the PL convention. The Centrão prioritizes strong congressional caucuses and prefers neutrality in the presidential race to retain flexibility in legislative alliances.

item.title: O trunfo que o governo Lula pode usar contra o tarifaço de Trump, segundo especialistas
item.description: The Lula government adopted a conciliatory stance toward the 25% U.S. tariffs on Brazilian goods, prioritizing negotiations with affected sectors like footwear and auto parts and ruling out immediate retaliation. Experts highlight that Vice President Geraldo Alckmin’s moderate approach brings stability to the talks, though skepticism remains about a swift reversal of the tariffs due to underlying political motives in the U.S. decision.

item.title: Priscila Costa, pivô da crise entre Flávio Bolsonaro e Michelle no Ceará, deixa disputa ao Senado e será candidata a deputada federal
item.description: Priscila Costa abandoned her Senate bid in Ceará after losing internal PL support and Michelle Bolsonaro’s backing, choosing to run again for federal deputy. The move followed a rift between Michelle and Flávio Bolsonaro over Senate nominations and the PL’s alliance with Ciro Gomes. With Alcides Fernandes secured as the PL’s Senate candidate, Priscila shifted her focus to reclaiming her seat in the Chamber of Deputies.

item.title: Justiça Eleitoral manda Meta remover santinho de Lula com ACM Neto e João Roma
item.description: Justice Mhércio Cerqueira Monteiro of the Bahia Regional Electoral Court (TRE-BA) ordered Meta to remove an Instagram post featuring a 'santinho' falsely suggesting an alliance between President Lula, ACM Neto, and João Roma, deemed electoral misinformation. The ruling aims to prevent the spread of deceptive content during the campaign period.

item.title: Lula decreta luto de 3 dias após morte do produtor Luiz Carlos Barreto
item.description: President Lula declared three days of official mourning following the death of Brazilian filmmaker and producer Luiz Carlos Barreto at age 98, praising his legacy in Cinema Novo and audiovisual policy. Lula highlighted Barreto’s defense of national film production, his role in building a professional talent pipeline, and his contribution to Brazil’s international acclaim through Oscars and Golden Lions.

item.title: Dívida com agências reguladoras cresce para R$ 135 bi
item.description: Federal regulatory agency debt reached R$135.1 billion in 2025, a 29.6% nominal increase from 2024, with only 34% deemed recoverable. The Lula government attempted to create a single negotiation portal to unify tax and non-tax debts, but the proposal stalled due to internal resistance, despite the 2024 Regulatory Agencies Desenrola program renegotiating R$4.9 billion.

item.title: Família Barreto e a relação com Lula: filme sobre presidente deu o que falar
item.description: The death of producer Luiz Carlos Barreto at age 98 revived discussion about the 2009 film 'Lula, o Filho do Brasil,' a biopic of President Lula directed by Fábio Barreto and produced by the Barreto family. Despite accusations of political bias, the family maintained the film aimed to portray a personal story of overcoming adversity, without electoral intent, and emphasized it avoided public funding to prevent financing controversies.

item.title: Milei cita Churchill após críticas à seleção argentina
item.description: Argentine President Javier Milei quoted a phrase attributed to Winston Churchill (though expressing doubts about its authenticity) in response to criticism of the Argentine men's football team after the 2026 World Cup final, where players turned their backs on Spain during the award ceremony. Milei also announced a meeting with São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas on Saturday, July 25, 2026, ahead of the PL convention that will formalize Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential candidacy, and reiterated his (denied) request to meet with imprisoned former President Jair Bolsonaro in Brasília.

item.title: Lula decreta luto oficial pela morte de Luiz Carlos Barreto
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva declared three days of official mourning for Luiz Carlos Barreto, the 98-year-old Brazilian cinema icon and pivotal producer of the Cinema Novo movement. Lula praised Barreto’s love for Brazil, his talent, and his restless spirit, calling him the most important national film producer of the last fifty years and highlighting his role in building a skilled audiovisual workforce that earned Brazil international acclaim, including Oscars and Golden Lions.

item.title: Após morte de Luiz Carlos Barreto, Lula decreta luto oficial e exalta legado do produtor e diretor
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva declared three-day mourning the producer Luiz Carlos Barreto, the father of the nation, declared an official three-day mourning period following the death of renowned film producer Luiz Carlos Barreto, aged 98. Lula praised Barreto's profound impact on Brazilian cinema, particularly his role in the Cinema Novo movement and iconic films such as 'Dona Flor and Her Two Husbands'.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro copia vídeo de Neymar com IA e promove encontro do ‘eu criança’ com ‘eu presidente’
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro released an AI-generated video depicting his imagined future as president, conversing with his childhood self in English and receiving her approval. The video mimics a similar one made by Neymar about the 2030 World Cup and is part of his broader strategy to use AI extensively to craft a heroic image and attack political rivals like Lula and criminal factions.

item.title: Lula decreta luto oficial de três dias pela morte do cineasta Luiz Carlos Barreto
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva declared three days of official mourning for the death of filmmaker Luiz Carlos Barreto, aged 98. Barreto, a central figure in Cinema Novo and producer of over 100 works, was honored for his contributions to Brazilian cinema, including films like 'Dona Flor e Seus Dois Maridos' and 'O Quatrilho', which brought Brazil to the Oscars. Lula emphasized his advocacy for Brazilian audiovisual and public policies for the sector.

item.title: CEO italiano da Stellantis brinca após microfone falhar em reunião com Lula: 'Deve ser de origem asiática a bateria'
item.description: During a meeting with President Lula and officials, Stellantis CEO Antonio Filosa joked about a malfunctioning microphone, saying it 'must have an Asian battery,' drawing laughter from Vice President Alckmin. Stellantis, which has partnerships with Chinese automakers on electric vehicles, presented its Brazil investments, while Lula reiterated his strategy to attract Asian automakers to boost sustainable industrialization and job creation in the auto sector.

item.title: TSE planeja poupar mulheres eleitas e cassar só homens se partido fraudar cota de gênero
item.description: The TSE plans to sanction parties that fraudulently comply with gender quotas by canceling only the mandates of elected men, while preserving seats won by women. The measure aims to deter sham female candidacies used solely to meet the legal 30% minimum threshold. The ruling will apply in cases of proven fraud by a party.

item.title: A melhora nos índices de aprovação de Lula, segundo nova pesquisa
item.description: A PoderData poll shows President Lula's personal approval rose from 42% to 46% in one week, while disapproval fell from 50% to 47%. Overall government approval held steady at 43% approve and 51% disapprove, but negative perception of Lula's work dropped ten points, from 47% to 37% rating it 'bad or terrible'.

item.title: Entenda: citado em fake news de Flávio, contrato da Smartmatic não se aplica à programação das urnas brasileiras
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro falsely claimed that the Venezuelan company Smartmatic had programmed Brazilian electronic voting machines to alter election results, a debunked myth rejected by the TSE since 2017. Smartmatic does not supply voting machines in Brazil; its involvement in Venezuela ended in 2017 after it alleged election fraud there. The senator reaffirmed trust in the electoral system but did not explain his reference to the false claim, reviving a narrative from 2022 promoted by his father, Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: Lindbergh diz que PT não pedirá inelegibilidade de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Federal Deputy Lindbergh Farias (PT-RJ) stated that the PT will not seek the ineligibility of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), arguing it would fuel a persecution narrative desired by the opposition. He advocates defeating Bolsonaro at the ballot box as the best response to his unfounded criticisms of the electoral system, reinforcing confidence in Brazil’s elections and highlighting the internationalization of distrust in the voting process, similar to Jair Bolsonaro’s 2022 actions.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro contrariou acordo assinado por Valdemar no TSE ao repetir dados falsos sobre urnas
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) violated the agreement signed by Valdemar Costa Neto at the TSE by repeating the false claim that Brazilian electronic voting machines originate from the Venezuelan company Smartmatic, a claim debunked by the court since 2020. The June 16 agreement committed parties to defend the integrity and reliability of the electoral system, yet Flávio, in a meeting with diplomats, spread already-refuted information, undermining the pledge to provide clear and secure information to voters.

item.title: PT lança campanha nacional contra tarifas e em defesa da soberania
item.description: The PT launched the national campaign 'Brazil Does Not Surrender' against U.S. tariffs on Brazilian products, defending Pix, national industry, and rare earths as symbols of sovereignty. The initiative coincides with a rise in Lula’s personal approval rating from 42% to 46% after the tariff announcement, according to PoderData. The party accuses the U.S. and the Bolsonaro family of attacking Brazil’s economy with personal and political interests above national interests.

item.title: Convenção de Caiado deve ter desfalque de apoiadores de outros candidatos
item.description: The PSD convention scheduled for Sunday (26) is set to formalize Ronaldo Caiado's presidential candidacy, but will face notable absences of party figures who support other candidates for the Presidency. These defections highlight internal divisions within the PSD over the party's 2026 presidential nominee.
